card.summary: The Investing in All of America Act of 2025 modifies how Small Business Investment Companies (SBICs) are funded and regulated by the Small Business Administration. It adjusts the maximum financing limits available to SBICs, expands what counts as private capital by including college and university endowments or trusts, and excludes certain investments—such as those in rural areas, critical technology fields, and small manufacturers—from standard financing calculations.
